title: Sprint 12 Review
raw_text:
Sarah: Sprint 12 review. Karim, is the migration done?

Karim: Yes. All 15 queries are rewritten. Staging tests pass. I ran the full test suite and everything is green. We are ready to deploy to production.

Sarah: Excellent. Let us schedule the production deployment for Wednesday March 19 during the maintenance window. Karim, you lead the deployment. Youssef, be on standby in case frontend issues come up.

Youssef: Got it. I will be available Wednesday evening.

Lina: For Sprint 13, we are picking up the dashboard feature that was deferred. I will have the requirements document ready by March 20.

Sarah: Perfect. Karim, after the deployment, your focus shifts to the dashboard backend API. Lina will share the specs.

Karim: Understood. I will wait for Lina's document before starting.

Sarah: Good sprint everyone. Meeting closed.
